body.title: Typed failures for git tools
body.summary: Add failureKind(r: ShellResult, opts) and withFailure(result, kind, original?, message?) to helpers.ts; change spawnFail and fail(label, r: ShellResult, opts) to use them (timeout warning only in failure.message); remove branch.ts's local copies; route status, diff, stage, merge, show, log, blame, rebase, cherry-pick, revert and the other failure sites through the helpers or withFailure while keeping legacy text and data; switch every runShell call site to pass the ShellResult; add the registration wrapper that gives kind rejected to any unsuccessful result lacking a failure. Expected non-zero outcomes (amend, reset, merge helper reads) stay apart from process failures.
acceptanceChecks: Every failure site in the LLD inventory returns a failure.kind: missing-tool for a spawn error, timed-out for a killed command, missing-signin or unreachable for push, pull, fetch, clone and ls-remote when git's message shows it, rejected otherwise
The registration wrapper adds kind rejected to an unsuccessful result without a failure and leaves one that has a failure untouched
Legacy output and error text of each failing call is unchanged
The existing git tool tests pass unchanged after this task, before t4 and t5 build on it
Expected non-zero outcomes of the amend, reset and merge helper reads are not reported as process failures

tests.name: src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-failures.test.ts: spawnFail and fail return the failure kind from the process outcome and git's message and keep output, format, success and error

src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-failures.test.ts: failureKind maps a ShellResult to missing-tool, timed-out, missing-signin, unreachable or rejected, and withFailure leaves output, format, success, error and data untouched
src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-failures.test.ts: the registration wrapper adds kind rejected to an unsuccessful result without a failure and leaves a set failure untouched
src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-failures.test.ts: the legacy output and error text of every existing failure path is unchanged

src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-failures.test.ts: a git tool in a directory that is not a repository, with git missing from PATH, and past its time limit returns a failure of the right kind
src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-failures.test.ts: git_merge with a conflict keeps its data and its merge conflict error and carries failure kind rejected
src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-failures.test.ts: a timed-out mutating call carries kind timed-out and the unknown-outcome sentence in failure.message
